title: Settings
saveFailed: Could not save the language preference. Restored {{language}}.

dialog.description: Manage application preferences and security options. SSH credentials are protected by the local encrypted vault.
dialog.resetConfirm: Restore the default settings for {{section}}? Only settings will change.
dialog.saveError: Could not save settings. The previous value is still shown: {{error}}

general.title: General
general.description: Manage workspace restoration and local connection history. SSH sessions, PTYs, and remote processes do not resume after the window restarts.

restoreWorkspace.title: Restore tabs and workspace
restoreWorkspace.description: Restores local tabs, panel layout, and the last SFTP path only. Remote processes are not restored.

autoConnect.title: Reconnect restored server tabs
autoConnect.description: Only SSH tabs from the previous workspace are considered. First-time host-key checks, missing credentials, and login confirmation still follow the normal security flow.

recentConnections.title: Keep recent connections
recentConnections.description: When disabled, no new recent-connection timestamps are recorded. Existing profiles, favorites, credentials, and trusted fingerprints remain.

checkUpdates.title: Check for updates at startup
checkUpdates.description: Checks in the background after startup. A non-blocking notice appears when an update is available; nothing is downloaded or installed automatically.

newTab.title: New tab
newTab.description: New tabs open the Quick Connect home.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.description: Font size and cursor changes apply to open SSH terminals immediately. Scrollback remains bounded.

fontSize.title: Terminal font size
fontSize.description: Range 11–24 px. Previewed immediately in the current session.

font.title: Font
font.description: Uses the system monospace font fallback list.

cursorBlink.title: Cursor blinking
cursorBlink.description: Controls cursor blinking in the current terminal.

colorScheme.title: Terminal color scheme
colorScheme.description: The terminal stays dark. Follow theme uses the application theme's default terminal colors.

scrollback.title: Scrollback buffer
scrollback.description: Limits the number of historical lines kept by each terminal. Session output is not persisted.

pastePreview.title: Review multiline paste
pastePreview.description: Previews multiline content and control characters. Oversized content and pastes while disconnected are still blocked by security checks.

clearHistory.title: Clear screen and scrollback separately
clearHistory.description: Terminal control sequences can clear the screen and scrollback separately. This page does not combine actions that could remove session state.

connections.title: Connections and Security
connections.description: Host identity checks are always on. Automatic reconnect requires both the global option and the per-connection option, plus available local credentials.

autoReconnect.title: Allow automatic reconnect
autoReconnect.description: Retries with exponential backoff up to five times. It must also be enabled for each server. A host-key change stops retries immediately.

hostKey.title: SSH host-key verification
hostKey.description: On first connection, choose whether to trust the key for this session or save it permanently. A changed trusted key blocks the connection.

trustedHosts.title: Trusted hosts and fingerprints
trustedHosts.description: Review each host's key algorithm, SHA256 fingerprint, and trust time. Revoking a key requires verification on the next connection.

timeout.title: SSH timeout
timeout.description: Uses the current SSH engine timeout policy. No separate timeout control is available in this version.

credentials.title: Saved login credentials
credentials.description: Passwords and private-key passphrases are protected by the local encrypted vault. Settings and status interfaces never read or return secrets.

sftp.title: File Transfers
sftp.description: Shows the transfer-safety policies currently implemented. No controls are shown for settings that are not connected to the backend.

concurrency.title: Concurrent transfers
concurrency.description: Transfers run sequentially within each SSH session to avoid simultaneous writes to remote destinations.

conflicts.title: File name conflicts
conflicts.description: When a destination exists, choose whether to skip, keep both, or overwrite for the current queue.

delete.title: Confirm remote deletion
delete.description: The target is shown and confirmation is required before deletion.

downloadLocation.title: Local download location
downloadLocation.description: Choose a destination with the system file picker for each download. No fixed location is saved.

editorConflict.title: Remote editor conflict checks
editorConflict.description: No separate modification-time option is shown because this version has no standalone remote text editor.

monitoring.title: Server Monitoring
monitoring.description: Monitoring data comes only from active SSH sessions. Pausing stops background sampling; no demo metrics are displayed.

enabled.title: Monitor current connections
enabled.description: Turning this off stops sampling for all current sessions. Turning it on monitors only sessions that are still connected.

hostSampling.title: Host, CPU, memory, and network sampling
hostSampling.description: Active session: every 2 seconds. Background session: every 15 seconds.

processSampling.title: Process sampling
processSampling.description: Active session: every 2 seconds. Background session: every 15 seconds. Process CPU is calculated from successive samples.

diskSampling.title: Disk sampling
diskSampling.description: Disk data is sampled every 20 seconds.

disconnect.title: Disconnected sessions
disconnect.description: Monitoring subscriptions stop when SSH disconnects, and old data is marked stale.

aiPrivacy.title: AI and Privacy
aiPrivacy.description: Read-only assistance never runs commands automatically. Terminal or file context is sent only after you select and preview each item.

provider.title: Model provider
provider.description: Only configured providers are shown. No simulated response is returned when a provider is missing.

context.title: Context sharing
context.description: Terminal and file context are not attached automatically. Review and authorize each request.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostic permissions
diagnostics.description: Diagnostic tools use a fixed allowlist of read-only commands. You review and approve each step; log content cannot grant permissions.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Keys are stored in the system credential store. The interface only reads whether a key is configured and never fills it back in. Manage providers in the AI panel.

history.title: Conversation history
history.description: Conversation context is isolated by SSH session and cleared from runtime state when the session closes.

appearance.title: Appearance and Shortcuts
appearance.description: Change the application theme and workspace startup preferences without changing the existing split layout.

theme.title: Application theme
theme.description: Follow system tracks operating-system light and dark appearance changes.

monitorSidebar.title: Server monitor sidebar
monitorSidebar.description: Shows or hides the monitor area on the left without changing connection state or monitor data.

aiPanel.title: Open AI panel by default
aiPanel.description: Off by default. This only controls the initial state on the next launch; it does not affect the current session.

density.title: Panel density
density.description: The workspace keeps its compact desktop layout.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts can be viewed here. Editing shortcuts is not available in this version.

aboutPanel.title: About {{name}}
aboutPanel.description: Product information and the running version.
aboutPanel.diagnosticsCopied: Redacted diagnostic information copied. It contains no host, account, path, key, or terminal content.
aboutPanel.diagnosticsCopyFailed: Could not copy diagnostic information. Check system clipboard permissions.
aboutPanel.descriptionText: A cross-platform remote workspace with SSH terminals, SFTP file management, server monitoring, and an AI Copilot.
aboutPanel.tagline: Your remote workspace, in one place.

vault.title: Credential vault
vault.unlockedKeychain: Vault unlocked. The master key is protected by the system credential store. Passwords and private-key passphrases are encrypted with AES-256-GCM.
vault.unlockedPassword: Vault unlocked for this session with the master password. Passwords and private-key passphrases are encrypted with AES-256-GCM.
vault.lockedPassword: Vault is locked. Enter the master password before saved credentials can be used.
vault.lockedKeychain: Vault is locked. The system credential store can be checked again for the master key.
vault.uninitialized: After setup, credentials you choose to remember are encrypted on this device.
vault.newPasswordMin: New master password, at least 12 characters
vault.repeatNewPassword: Enter the new master password again
vault.mismatch: The master passwords do not match.
vault.newMismatch: The new master passwords do not match.
vault.confirmRotate: Rotation re-encrypts all local credentials in the vault. Continue?
vault.confirmKeychainRotate: Rotation creates a new master key and re-encrypts all local credentials. Continue?
vault.error: Could not complete the vault operation.

keyManager.title: SSH keys
keyManager.locked: Unlock the vault to manage keys
keyManager.passphraseStorage: The private key is encrypted with a passphrase before it is stored in the local vault. Keep the passphrase safe.
keyManager.importPrompt: Choose an OpenSSH private key to import
keyManager.importPassphrase: Passphrase for the encrypted key (if any)
keyManager.exportSafety: The export is encrypted with a new passphrase and created with permissions limited to the current user. Enter the current passphrase if the source key is encrypted. The destination file must not already exist.
keyManager.sourcePassphraseHint: Current passphrase (if the source key is encrypted)
keyManager.newExportPassphrase: New export passphrase, at least 8 characters
keyManager.passphraseMismatch: The export passphrases do not match.
keyManager.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{alias}}” and its private key from the vault? This cannot be undone.
keyManager.generated: SSH key generated and encrypted in the local vault.
keyManager.imported: SSH private key verified and encrypted in the local vault.
keyManager.exported: SSH key exported with the new passphrase.
keyManager.copyFailed: Could not copy the SSH public key. Check system clipboard permissions.
